The PONS ecosystem has grown into one of the most active parts of the Robinhood Chain meme economy.

With $PONS reaching a new ATH above $100M+ market cap, we started thinking about a simple question: 

what happens if the fees generated by the PONS creator economy can flow back to a new class of holders? That idea became PONS Fees.

The first PONS protocol built around creator fees

PONS Fees is designed around one simple mechanism:
creator fees → $FEES → $PONS holders
But there's an important difference.

You don't simply hold $PONS participate. You need to hold $FEES.
$FEES becomes the access layer for the reward mechanism, while the reward itself is $PONS. In other words: Hold $FEES → receive $PONS rewards.

The more $FEES you hold, the larger your share of the available reward pool can become, depending on the distribution mechanism.
